name: Financial Position / Balance

Interoperability hold: every IFRS, ISO 20022, XBRL, IMF, ECB, SEC, GLEIF, ISO 4217, PROV, DQV and time projection requires version pins, conformance evidence and information-loss declarations.
Privacy hold: confidential, personal, account-level, market-sensitive, counterparty, valuation, collateral, netting and regulatory data require purpose-bound access and minimization.
